verdict.rationale: dltHub documents deploying pipelines with a single `dlthub deploy` command and then scheduling, refreshing, backfilling and observing runs through a decorator-based Python API on managed infrastructure. Its orchestration product schedules and chains pipelines, with every run logged, auditable and monitorable via the CLI and Web UI. Self-hosted background runs are also covered through GitHub Actions, Airflow or serverless functions, and the AI Harness lets coding agents deploy and run pipelines. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how autonomous agent-driven scheduling actually works (triggers, failure handling or alerting), and independent or hands-on confirmation that scheduled runs work in practice.
